dedupe_keys.name: high frequency water quality and discharge data for selected stormwater facilities in baltimore county md usa

description: High-frequency water quality and discharge data for selected stormwater facilities in Baltimore County, MD, USA is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Welty, Claire (deposited on HydroShare). This resource is a repository for water quality and discharge data collected at the inlets and outlets of three stormwater facilities in Baltimore County, MD, USA. EXO sondes outfitted with temperature, SC, and turbidity sensors, SUNAs (for measuring nitrate), and Blue Siren depth and velocity sensors were installed in fall/winter 2025-2026. Coverage: United States. The resource was created 2025-12-27 and last updated 2026-05-16; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the resource metadata. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
